inv.desc_en:
AURIGA Real Estate offers a magnificent commercial space on a corner with a surface area of 148 m2. All on the ground floor with direct access from the street. This fabulous space features a large 16-meter corner façade, with glass storefronts all around, located at the intersection of Calle Lopez de Hoyos and Calle Eugenio Salazar, both with high pedestrian and vehicle traffic. Great visibility. The street and area are VERY COMMERCIAL. Entirely distributed on the ground floor, with direct street access and no architectural barriers, and a good showcase providing excellent commercial visibility. Magnificent location.
- Surface area: 148 m2.
- Façade: 16 linear meters on the corner with good street access and a great showcase.
- Height: 3.30 meters interior.
- License: Last activity was a bank office.
- Smoke Exit: NONE Available.
- Availability: IMMEDIATE for Sale and Rental.
Please do not hesitate to contact us for more information about the asset regarding tenant, guarantees, mandatory compliance, etc.
No specific address of the premises or photos are provided at the explicit request of the owner. The photos are not representative of the property, they are of the surroundings and for illustrative purposes. For more information about the space and its conditions, please feel free to contact us without obligation. We have more vacant properties and income-producing ones with the best operators and tenants, as well as guarantees of contracts in profitability.
AURIGA Real Estate.
